Definition: Dahava, a people colonized in Samaria
BiblicalUsage: The Dehavites appear once, named among the peoples settled in Samaria who wrote to stop the rebuilding of the temple. They are one of the colonist peoples the Assyrians planted in the land after carrying Israel away.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse reminds us that opposition to God's work often comes from people who were planted there by someone else's empire.
